task.goal: Implement the smallest branch-local metabolism engine and fixtures needed to prove two-backup enforcement and safe staged garbage cleanup.
required_behaviors: represent exactly RECOVERY_BASELINE and WORKING_EXCHANGE as the only allowed full backup groups
reject creation/materialization of a third full backup group
classify fixture artifacts as KEEP, QUARANTINE, WASTE, or DELETE_CANDIDATE
allow auto-clear only when reachability, uniqueness, reproducibility and recovery guards all pass
protect current stable/recovery, unique, referenced, unreproducible and governance/identity material
produce deterministic before/after manifest hashes and a compact metabolism report
negative_tests: protected recovery baseline mutation/deletion is rejected

acceptance: no real protected user material deleted
B emits one compact Evidence file and one B→C packet only
forbidden: create more than two full backup groups
